title: UFO said to hover over channeling sessions

tellings.quote: right now, there's a a UFO that's sort of hovering over this session and and some claim to have witnessed that.

plain: In the 1970s, a UFO was said to hover over channeling sessions, meetings where people believed messages from non-human beings came through a human speaker, held in the lab of a scientist named Puharich. An unnamed researcher tells Michels about it, saying that messages from a group he calls the "space kids" announced that "there's a UFO that's sort of hovering over this session," and that "some claim to have witnessed that."
